summary: My name is Caucher Birkar. I'm a professor of mathematics at the University of Cambridge. I think it's important to have something original something authentic both in mathematics and also generally in life. Because I believe that a lot of problem in the world, social and political, arise because people imitate other people, because countries imitate other countries. It's okay to learn from others, to take ideas and to develop it. But it's not good I think just to imitate others.
